title: SU(2)-Equivariant Spinor Message Passing for Molecular Magnetism
abstract: arXiv:2610.29111v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting molecular magnetism often requires electronic-structure calculations with spin-orbit coupling (SOC), which are costly to repeat across many molecules. The underlying electronic states can transform as spinors, yet equivariant surrogates typically use only integer-rank features. Inspired by the spinor nature of these electronic states, we develop eSpinor, an SU(2)-equivariant graph neural network that propagates spinor features. We initialize spinor features from eigenvectors of an approximate SOC Hamiltonian and use gauge-covariant message passing with a gauge-invariant readout to make predictions independent of the arbitrary eigenbasis choice. On cobalt single-molecule magnet candidates, eSpinor improves zero-field-splitting predictions relative to NequIP, including for unseen ligands. translated_title: 面向分子磁性的SU(2)-等变旋量消息传递
translated_abstract: 预测分子磁性通常需要进行包含自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的电子结构计算，而在大量分子上重复此类计算代价高昂。其底层电子态可以按旋量（spinor）形式变换，然而现有的等变代理模型通常仅使用整数阶特征。受这些电子态旋量性质的启发，我们开发了eSpinor——一种传播旋量特征的SU(2)-等变图神经网络。我们从近似SOC哈密顿量的本征向量初始化旋量特征，并采用规范协变的消息传递与规范不变的读出层，使预测结果独立于任意的本征基选择。在钴基单分子磁体候选物上，eSpinor相较于NequIP改进了零场分裂的预测，包括对未见过的配体。对于一种镝基磁共振成像探针，eSpinor在真实电子自旋关联方面也优于基于哈密顿量信息的基线方法。
tldr: 本文提出eSpinor，一个通过传播旋量特征并结合规范协变消息传递与规范不变读出的SU(2)-等变图神经网络，显著提升了分子磁性性质（如零场分裂和电子自旋关联）的预测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces eSpinor, an SU(2)-equivariant graph neural network that propagates spinor features via gauge-covariant message passing and gauge-invariant readout, substantially improving predictions of molecular magnetism properties such as zero-field splitting and electron-spin correlations.
